title: User events belong in event handlers

slides.say: Two buttons, Buy and Checkout, both add to cart and should show a notification. Putting it in an Effect seems neat. It is a bug.
If the cart is saved between reloads, refreshing the page shows the notification again. Product is already in the cart on load.
Move it into a function and call it from both handlers. The notification now happens because the user pressed a button.

slides.text: Effects are for code that runs because the component was displayed.
slides.say: Use Effects only for code that should run because the component was displayed, not because of a click.
